notes.title: Public Beta Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Total Miner Public Beta Update[/h1]
Total Miner 2.20.7.1906, with animation additions, general gameplay fixes and tweaks is available for download.

[b]Backup Your Save Directory Before Switching[b]

[b]Updated to .NET 8[b]

[b]Instructions[b]
[list]
[*]Right Click on "Total Miner"
[*]Select "Betas" Tab
[*]Select Drop Down & Choose Open Beta
[/list]

[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]
[u][b]This update includes but is not limited to the following changes/additions/fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Plugins could not add custom NPCs.
[*]Fixed: Incorrect sliding block (eg. teflon) collision.
[*]Fixed: Mods not installing in certain cases.
[*]Fixed: Texture Pack dropdown going offscreen in certain cases.
[*]Fixed: Fixed One Way Glass texture visible on all sides.
[*]Fixed: String seeds changing after game reload.
[*]Fixed: Inventory screens breaking on season change.
[*]Fixed: Spectating now shows NPCs around other players.
[*]Fixed: Texture fixes (Jectz).
[*]Fixed: Legendary now works in multiplayer.
[*]Fixed: Multiplayer NPC targeting.
[*]Fixed: Trees cut off at chunk borders.
[*]Fixed: Some chunk meshes not loading.
[*]Fixed: System component pack menu sometimes mistakes player component pack as system packs.
[*]Fixed: Player input menu not allowing save after editing key.
[*]Fixed: Attack node serialization.

[*]Tweaked: Behaviour command can now only set behaviours for players in creative.
[*]Tweaked: World browser menu no longer shows worlds on different version.
[*]Updated: NPC Models & Animations
[*]Added Workshop Support
[*]- Some mods might not work due to targeting a different version of the game.

[*]Added Lua functions:
[*]- is_cursor_valid()
[*]- get_cursor_point()
[*]- get_cursor_face()
[*]- get_cursor_distance()
[*]- get_placement_point()
[*]- add_flying_block()
[*]- set_falling_block()
[*]Added: New Texture Packs (The Map Cartographer)
[*]Added: Survival Enemy Combat Rebalance
[*]Added: Fire Burning and Ice Freeze effects for Players/NPCs.
[*]Added: Fire and Ice Resistance/Vulnerability properties for Players/NPCs.
[*]Added: Power and Accuracy properties for Bows.
[*]Added: Multi-shot capability for Bows.
[*]Added: Piercing capability for Arrows.
[*]Added: Bow Range.
[*]Added: Better XML mod error reporting.
[*]Added: World player bans.
[*]Added: Player-based economy shops.
[/list]
And many more fixes not listed here

[h2]Workshop Support[/h2]
This public beta has support for the Steam Workshop, you can upload mods by clicking "Upload" in the mod info screen, and upload worlds by dragging them onto the upload button in the world browser menu.
If you encounter any issues with the workshop, be sure to let us know.
Feel free to join our Discord to talk to us and report any issues.

Thank you all to who support the game and the team :)

 - TM Dev Team

notes.title: Total Miner Retail Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Total Miner Steam PC Retail Update[/h1]
Total Miner Version 2.10.8.1613 is now live and available for download as the retail version of the game. 
 This means you should opt out of any betas you are in, if any, to update to this latest version.

[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]
Thousands of bugs have been squashed and dozens of features implemented since the last retail release several years ago, and we felt that the current state of the game now should replace the old.

[h2]Moving Forward[/h2]
A regular update schedule being established to get updates out ever 2-4 weeks both on retail and beta.  The idea behind this approach is to have content tested and published within a consistent schedule, even if the update isn't big or a new feature.  

Thank you to all who support the team.

notes.title: Multiplayer Public Beta Release 2.9.4
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings[/h1]

Our latest update for the Multiplayer Public Beta is now live.

This version is fully multiplayer capable and very close to what we will be releasing as the full public retail Total Miner 3.0 release.

So jump in, take a look, and join in the worlds of fun. If there aren't any to join, start one, and hopefully others will join ;)

There are hundreds of changes and fixes in new this version. Mostly around multiplayer and networking, and porting the remaining old screens to the new interface. There are also a lot of QOL improvements.

And here are a few notable additions:
[list]
[*]Player Stamina.
[*]New Mod Management tab.
[*]New World Preview tab.
[*]Mouse Look At fixes.
[*]New Dig Deep Nexus Tower.
[*]New Spider.
[/list]
We've also added in some frame based animation for the naturally spawning NPCs, just for some fun. This is not our final animation, but it is good for the interim.

We are still having problems with Dig Deep blueprints, so we'd advise not to play Dig Deep on this version. It will be fixed before the full 3.0 release.

Cheers from the TM Dev team: Craig, XBL, Native, Dave & Syn.
And everyone from our testing team and discord admins.

notes.title: Total Miner 3.0
notes.notes:
Hi All

We want to let you know we are almost there. Progress over the last 3 months has been solid. And we intend more of the same until 3.0 released.

It appears all the heavy lifting for multi-player has been completed. A networking architecture for the game, an interface to Steam networking, and replacing all the legacy Xbox Live networking code where necessary.

We have also completed most of the work to ensure all of TM's game play works well with multi-player. But there is still a number of smaller details that need to be fixed or redone.

We have also completed a lot of the general PC port work that was not finished on the current version.

Cheers
Craig

notes.title: Total Miner 3.0
notes.notes:
Hi All

Development of the game did stop in 2020, and this pause lasted about a year. 

Since then, for the last few months, a couple of TM devs have been quietly chipping away at multi-player, and it is now working well. 

So we think now is the right time to announce the upcoming release of Total Miner 3.0.

This is the multi-player release.

There is still some work to do to make it ready for release, and we are working on that as much as we can. 

We are not able to give a reasonable estimate for the release date yet, but we think we will be in a position to do that soon.

There are also a bunch of quality of life improvements included in the release. These will be detailed closer to actual release.

Cheers
TM Team

notes.title: Total Miner Returns!
notes.notes:
Total Miner's development which has been on hiatus since March of 2019, will now be resuming. Our long awaited multiplayer update is expected to release spring 2020.

[b]Upcoming update priorities:[/b]  [list]
[*]MonoGame port
[*]Multiplayer networking code
[*]Correcting mouse control stability
[/list]

General bug fixes and tweaks are expected as well, but the above will likely be the major items you can expect.

We apologize for the lack of communication over the past year, and will be doing our very best to stay transparent and open with the community. We are thankful for the tremendous support everyone has given TM over the years.

You can follow our progress in detail here: https://trello.com/b/HB1s1xhH/totalminer

Make sure to join us on our official Discord server here: https://discord.gg/totalminer

notes.title: Multiplayer development
notes.notes:
Multiplayer development will now start.

There will be some small updates for other fixes and improvements while multiplayer is being worked on, but most effort now will go towards getting multiplayer ready for release.

See [url=http://totalminerforums.net/index.php?topic=19315.0]here[/url] for a modded multiplayer solution in the interim. This mod provides a replacement for the Xbox Live servers and leverages the games existing multiplayer code for Xbox. Note all new PC features are not yet supported, and some features which I've changed during the PC port also will not work properly. But basic multiplayer hosting and building is possible.

For those having problems with windows file access in the default Documents\My Games\TotalMiner path or if you just want to change it to something else, add an entry into the game.ini file like so:

SaveRoot=D:\GameSaves\TotalMiner

or whatever path you want that will not give the access errors.

To access the game.ini file, right click Total Miner in your library, select Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files.
